name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Your posting draws a line I care about: clients who "have" the software versus clients who actually run their work on it. That gap is where I've spent most of my career. At Wix I onboarded and launched 25+ clients a month and trained onboarding teams of up to 30. At Birdeye I trained a partner network on marketing automation, watched utilization to find the accounts slipping, and retained all but one of 15-20 partners.

The shift your clients make, from manual AP to automated workflows, is the same one I guide owners through at Solenzo. I map how the work actually happens today, rebuild it as an automated system, and train the people who have to live with it. The resistance is rarely technical. It's habit and trust, and it moves faster when each person (a clerk, a controller, an owner) sees what changes for them specifically.

To be direct: I haven't worked inside AP or finance operations. The closest I've come is walking professional-services firms through Accelo's invoicing and billing features, so I know how a billing workflow looks to the people running it, and I'd learn the invoice-to-payment lifecycle quickly on your side of the table. I'm comfortable in Salesforce and presenting anywhere from a 1:1 deep dive to a room of 50+. I'd welcome a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
